hooks.command: $h = "$env:CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/private_data_guard.py"; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $h)) { exit 0 }; if (-not (Get-Command python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('private_data_guard: python is not on PATH, so the guard is not active'); exit 1 }; python $h; exit $LASTEXITCODE
